summary: Diageo plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing four London Stock Exchange announcements dated October 2026: a Total Voting Rights notice (issued capital 2,432,397,125 ordinary shares, 204,816,853 held in treasury, 2,227,580,272 voting rights as of 30 September 2026) and three Director/PDMR shareholding disclosures under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Chair Sir John Manzoni purchased 400 shares at 16.40 on 12 October 2026, and Executive Committee member Dayalan Nayager reported participation in the Diageo 2001 Share Incentive Plan. No special-situation event, transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory clocks are present; this is ordinary disclosure housekeeping.
